prompt: Match each keyspace command to its effect.
explanation: EXPIRE and PEXPIRE attach timeouts in seconds and milliseconds; PERSIST detaches the timeout; SET with EX writes value and timeout atomically; TTL and PTTL read the remaining time; and DEL differs from UNLINK in who does the freeing work.

pairs.right: Gives the existing key a 30-second timeout
Writes the value and its timeout in one atomic call
Removes the timeout, keeping the value
Remaining time to live in milliseconds
Removes the key at once, reclaims memory in a background thread
Removes the key and reclaims the memory in the calling thread
